ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (at times referred to as the "Agreement"), made as of the 30th day of March, 2026, by and between 218 ASHFORD LLC, a Suite #621, Brooklyn, New York 11207, (referred to herein as “Parcel A Owner"), and 2916 ATLANTIC AVE LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 51 Forest Road, Suite 316-76, Monroe, New York 10950, (referred to herein as “Parcel B Owner"). Parcel A Owner and Parcel B Owner are sometimes hereinafter referred to individually as a “Party” or collectively as the“Parties". WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Parcel A Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn and County of Kings, City and State of New York,generally known as and by the street address 218 Ashford Street,Brooklyn,New York,and designated as Tax Lot 24 in Block 3967 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as the“Parcel A Land,” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Building,”- the Parcel A Land and WHEREAS,Parcel B Owner is the owner of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn and County of Kings, City and State of New York,generally known as and by the street address 2916Atlantic Avenue,Brooklyn,NewYork, and designated as Tax Lot 15 in Block 3967 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on to as the “Parcel B Land,” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, as the “Parcel B Building,” - the Parcel B Land and the Parcel B Building being herein collectively referred to as "Parcel B"); WHEREAS, Parcel B Owner intends to construct the Parcel B Building on Parcel B with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Parcel B under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if Parcel B were to be considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Parcel A,if Parcel A were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, that are in excess of the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended ("Zoning Resolution");
